conventions.problem_id: sphere/N/P: P congruent pieces on the whole sphere of radius rho (no container); N = 0 disks of geodesic diameter 1 (radius 1/2), N >= 3 regular spherical N-gons of geodesic side 1
conventions.score: rho, the sphere radius (smaller is better); curvature K = 1/rho^2
conventions.units: lengths in units of the piece (side 1 / disk diameter 1); poses on the unit sphere
conventions.pose: q = [w, x, y, z] (any nonzero quaternion; the piece is G(standard piece), G = rotation of q/|q|, v -> q v q*). Standard piece: centre e3 = (0,0,1), vertex k at (sin R cos phi_k, sin R sin phi_k, cos R), phi_k = pi/2 + 2 pi k/N (vertex up = +y), sin(1/(2 rho)) = sin R sin(pi/N). Gauge: piece 0 has q = [1,0,0,0]. G = T(c) R_z(theta) recovers the curved package's (centre, theta) pose away from the south pole.
conventions.validity: interiors disjoint (touching allowed); score_cert is a radius at which the stored configuration is proven strictly valid by python/sphere/certify.py (mpmath intervals, 256 bits)
conventions.display: score_cert rounded to the nearest at 6 decimals (half-even, from its exact binary64 value)
conventions.status: proven only when a published proof establishes the optimum and the record matches it within the certification gap; best_known otherwise
